description: This file defines the Banner controller class within the OpenCart admin module. It handles tasks related to listing, generating, retrieving information, and clearing banner files for different stores and languages in an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banner tasks within the OpenCart admin module, including generating banner lists, retrieving banner info, and clearing cached banner files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes banner tasks by creating scheduled tasks for each store and language combination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates JSON file containing banner data for a specific store and language.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed information about a specific banner, including saving the banner data to a JSON file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated banner JSON files for all stores and languages.
